title: Sarbacher: craft at Wright-Patterson taken over by Anderson trust, MIT's Compton

tellings.quote: sarbacher says that uh uh there was a craft being held at rright Patterson and that craft was taken over by uh the Anderson trust

plain: According to a scientist named Robert Sarbacher, a craft was being held at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, and was then taken over by a group called the Anderson trust, which the story ties to Karl Compton of MIT. If true, a recovered craft would have passed out of the military's hands into a private circle of scientists. Michels relays it as what Sarbacher says, citing along the way names such as the researcher William Steinman, the Canadian engineer Wilbert B. Smith and the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown.
